skillset.skill: 15s CT - 2700% Light DMG (PHY). Increase Human allies' Arts by 20. For 10s, gain a DMG barrier that negates 2000 DMG.
skillset.arts: 23000% Light DMG (PHY). Each time Arts is used, permanently increase own PHY DMG and Break Power by 50% (MAX: 500%).
skillset.truearts: 100000% Light DMG (PHY). For 15s, reduce enemies' Light RES by 100%. Additionally if used when own HP is 100%, double the DMG Multiplier of current True Arts.
skillset.superarts: 150000% Light DMG (PHY). For 45s, reduce enemies' Break RES by 20%. Additionally, increase own DMG against enemies under 50% HP by 300% and own DMG against Broken enemies by 200% for the duration of Super Arts.

passive.ability1: When above 80% HP, increase own Arts by 1/s and ignore 100% of enemies' DEF. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: When a barrier is active on self, increase own ATK by 40%.
passive.ability3: Increase own Break Power by [2% × own ATK/100].
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Mami Tomoe's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Mami Tomoe's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Mami's Musket
trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 5000% Light DMG (PHY). For 10s, reduce enemies' Light RES by 40%. Additionally if user is Human, for 10s, increase own ATK by 40%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Mami, increase own Skill CT Speed and Equip CT Speed by 20%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
